snippet.title: Five New-Fangled Nights | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
It's here! Our rubberhose FNaF fan-game, Five New-Fangled Nights, is finally finished! Go give it a play! (Or just watch a Youtuber play it, I dunno)

https://gamejolt.com/games/ifyourereadingthisyouvegotagoodeye/807961

Thank you all so much for stickin' by the channel for so long, and for your patience while we poured our blood, sweat and ink into this game! Hope you enjoy it!

Trailer editing and 3d animation by @BitbyBit06 

Freddy-Bear voiced by @CosmicStarVA 

Song used is "Five Foot Two, Eyes of Blue" by Spike Jones

FNaF Plus Freddy model by @Ubuntutu99!

#fnaf #fnaffangames #fangame #fivenightsatfreddys #fnaffangame #animation #vintage
